import glob,sys
fs=glob.glob(sys.argv[1]+'/director-finance-*.md')
assert len(fs)==1,fs
t=open(fs[0],encoding='utf-8').read()
sec=t.split('## Công nợ đại lý quá hạn',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0]
head=[c.strip() for c in next(l for l in sec.splitlines() if l.startswith('| Đại lý')).strip('|').split('|')]
rows=[l for l in sec.splitlines() if l.startswith('| `')]
n=lambda s:int(s.strip().replace('.','').replace('đ','') or 0)
bad=[]
for l in rows:
    r=dict(zip(head,[c.strip() for c in l.strip('|').split('|')]))
    if sum(n(r[k]) for k in ('0-30','31-60','61-90','>90'))!=n(r['Quá hạn']): bad.append(l)
print('cot',head,'so_dong',len(rows),'lech',bad)
sys.exit(0 if '0-30' in head and len(rows)==3 and not bad else 1)
